text: Planning is done. This is the first real code -- T-SQL against EVERPEAK_PROD, building the actual training dataset.
Every row hangs off one parameter, OBSERVATION_DATE. Accounts already churned by that date are excluded entirely -- there's nothing left to predict for them.
The label: did ChurnDate fall strictly after OBSERVATION_DATE and within the next 90 days. That's a one if yes, zero if the account stayed active the whole window.
Accounts and Subscriptions join in for plan and revenue. UsageEvents, SupportTickets, and Invoices get staged raw -- the windowed features come in the next lesson, not this one.
One flat, labeled, joined extract comes out the other side. Next: turning that raw staged data into the actual engineered features.
